description: Remote Commander route down; attempt repair under local recovery authority without widening permissions.

steps.description: Capture current MCP gateway state and recent errors
command: ps aux | grep -i -e remote-commander -e mcp | grep -v grep | head -10 || true

steps.description: Check whether the Remote Commander service is listening (informational; optional)
command: lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P | grep -i -e commander -e node | head -10 || true

steps.description: Restart the Remote Commander launchd job if present
command: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.aineko.remote-commander || echo 'no launchd job under that label; inspect inventory'

steps.description: Verify authority state is readable and audit intact
